map.从 n 个元素取 r 个的排列数。: The number of permutations of r items chosen from n elements.
map.计算考虑顺序的安排数，如密码、排队、赛程: Count ordered arrangements, such as passwords, queues, and schedules
map.给 n 个物品排前 k 个位置的方式数: The number of ways to place n items in the top k positions
map.在概率里算有序样本空间大小: Compute the size of an ordered sample space in probability
map.10 个人选前 3 个领奖座位，: Choosing the top 3 award seats from 10 people, the
map.P(10,3)=10×9×8=720。每换一个座位顺序都算不同结果。: P(10,3)=10×9×8=720. Every change of seating order counts as a different result.
map.n 个物品全排列为 n!=n×(n-1)×…×1；3 本书排架上 = 3!=6: The full permutation of n items is n!=n×(n−1)×…×1; 3 books on a shelf = 3! = 6 ways.
map.P(n,k)=n!/(n-k)!，即从 n 开始连乘 k 个数。例 P(10,3: P(n,k)=n!/(n−k)!, i.e. multiply k numbers starting from n. E.g. P(10,3)=10!/7!=10×9×8.
map.什么时候用全排列 n!？: When do you use the full permutation n!?
map.当 k=n（全部排完）时 P(n,n)=n!。只要所有物品都参与排序就用全排列。: When k=n (everything is arranged), P(n,n)=n!. Whenever all items take part in the ordering, use the full permutation.
